newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - Chartists neutral to positive on Bel-20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Chartists neutral to positive on Bel-20.

text.p: Belgian analysts were neutral to positive about the trend of the Bel-20 share index after the sharp sell-off following last Thursday's all-time high which, they said, had been created artificially.
The Bel-20 ended at 1,794.11 on Friday, well down from Thursday's record 1,829.85 close, but still comfortably above the 1,773.21 points close the previous Friday.

CERA - As the rally in the bond markets continues after the Belgian government presented a 1997 budget that could ensure Belgium will qualify for the Euro, the Bel-20 could break above first resistance of 1,800. We believe retailers could lead the rise in the coming week. Fortis, the Belgian-Dutch banking and insurance company, will be in the spotlight after signing a letter of intent to buy MeesPierson, the merchant banking unit of ABN Amro. First resistance is at the psychologically important level of 1,800, second at the last high of 1,829 (on 3/10/96). At 1,750 and 1,700 there are technical support levels. -- Guy Sips.

ECOFIS - The window or gap between 1,780 and 1,784 between last Tuesday and Wednesday is undeniably bullish, especially because the gap occurred at levels where previously local all-time tops formed i.e. in March, in May and in August 1996. The low of that window in terms of bodies now becomes a first support level. The Bel-20 like other equity markets was boosted by booming bond markets, inspired by the belief or hope that cheap money could endure in Japan, Germany and the U.S. After the odd day of Thursday and the small-bodied candle of Friday, the Bel-20 may pause for breath above 1,780. -- Frank Boll.

PARIBAS - The ascending triangle pattern seen on the daily chart in the last couple of months was broken last week as resistance at 1,780 gave way. This strong resistance level has now become a very strong support level, and a break on the downside would probably reverse the short-term bullish trend. As momentum on the daily chart continues to show upward potential, we suggest positioning long on Bel-20 towards our target zone between 1,850 and 1,880 and putting a stop-loss just below 1,780. -- Philip Tortelboom
